Process

Three steps, kept plain. You always know what’s happening and what comes next.

Understand the problem

We start with what’s actually stuck — being found, getting booked, or selling and supporting online — and agree on the one thing the project needs to fix.

Design and build

The site or tool is designed and built around that problem. No technology for its own sake, and no unnecessary complexity.

Launch and improve

Once it’s live, we check it’s doing its job and make the next step easier where it isn’t. Good digital work should feel like a natural extension of your business.

About

Vertigo AI is an independent practice run by Sharif. It’s a small studio by design: you deal directly with the person thinking through and building your project, from the first email to launch.

The work is websites, online stores and practical AI tools for small businesses — built to be used, not just looked at.
